_comment: LibreSpot custom SpotX patches, demonstration. Loaded through LibreSpot's Custom Install > Custom Patches (SpotX_CustomPatchesJson), which SpotX consumes via -CustomPatchesPath. Every entry follows the real SpotX patches.json shape: a version gate plus a regex match/replace against a named xpui file. These are cosmetic-only patches applied at the SpotX layer, so they survive even without Spicetify. Nothing here touches ads, premium state, telemetry, or any binary.

prism_compact_rows._comment: Tighten track-row height for a denser list, a long-standing layout request with no native toggle.

prism_css._comment: Appended to xpui.css. 'add' entries are concatenated onto the file by SpotX's extract(-add). Hides the Now Playing view upsell nag and rounds album art without needing a full theme.
